core_obligations: Reduce to a quasi-compact base (proof line 20154): it is enough to prove the statement when Y is quasi-compact.
Bound the dimension (proof lines 20155-20158): by the dimension bound for morphisms of finite type the fibres of f have bounded dimension, so the proper dimension lemma gives cd(f) < infinity.
Conclude (proof lines 20159-20161): the finite-cohomological-dimension lemma for Z/nZ coefficients then gives commutation of Rf_* with direct sums.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a quasi-compact base and bound the fibre dimension.
Apply the proper dimension bound to get finite cohomological dimension, then the commutation lemma.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the derived pushforward along a proper morphism, with coefficients in Z/nZ, commutes with direct sums (statement lines 20140-20151). The proof (proof lines 20153-20161) reduces to a quasi-compact base, bounds the fibre dimension by the finite type input, applies the proper dimension bound to get finite cohomological dimension, and then the commutation lemma. H2: two reductions plus one application.
